reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki at hmbeki@pemberline.com and replied to you in our DM to say so. It hasn't been sent; someone still has to send it.

- Subject: "Quarrendon Freight Lines – proposed 2027 per-seat rate"
- Body: gives the $2,356 per-seat figure and notes that you approved sharing it with him.

No other approval was needed. As CFO you can approve sharing a finance figure yourself, and Hollis has an internal address, so Ruth's sign-off for outside mail doesn't apply. I took the rate from your message as it stood and didn't check it against any other source.
